```yaml
name: Conformance

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Publish to npm
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

      - name: Cache node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-npm-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run CI checks
        run: npm run check

      - name: Build package
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish to npm
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npm publish

  publish-gh-pages:
    name: Generate and deploy API documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: publish
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Git for documentation
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Generate and push documentation
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          bash scripts/generate-gh-pages.sh ${{ github.ref_name }}

      - name: Documentation deployment complete
        run: echo "Documentation generated and pushed to gh-pages branch."
```
